description: Bass drum voice: a sine core through a wave shaper, with a pitch envelope and a decay envelope

params.text: Sets the base pitch of the drum, from 27.5Hz to 123.47Hz
Fires the drum by hand, one hit per press
Bends the sine core towards a square as it is turned up
Sets how long the drum takes to fade, from 0.075 seconds to 4 seconds
Sets how long the pitch envelope takes to fall, from 0.0075 seconds to 1 second
Sets how far the pitch envelope lifts the pitch at the start of the hit, reaching 10000Hz at the top of its travel

inputs.text: A rising edge fires the drum; it reads high above 4V and low below 0.2V
Sets the output level, 0-10V from silence to full; with nothing patched the level is full
Volt-per-octave pitch: each volt doubles the base pitch that TUNE sets
Adds to the SHAPE knob, 0-10V covering its whole range
Lengthens the fade by a tenth of a second per volt, added to the decay slider, and the result is held between 0.01 seconds and 10 seconds

outputs.text: The finished bass drum, reaching 10V peak to peak at full level

inputs.0: high above 4V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
